subject: Aperture Analytics — temporary invoice-only onboarding / PO exception request
messages:
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@aperture-analytics.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Aperture Analytics Finance <finance@aperture-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-02-03T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: New pilot - procurement questions and docs attached

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the quick product demo yesterday — excited to kick off the 30-day pilot. Before we can get started on our side I need to sort procurement: our internal purchasing team is asking whether a Redwood PO is required for the pilot. Aperture's standard policy typically requires a PO, but for short pilots our system sometimes can't issue one (legal/finance gates).

A few details that may help you decide:
- Pilot value: estimated $1,800 – $2,200 total (under $5k).
- Contract term: 30 days trial, one-time SOW covering scope and success metrics.
- Billing cadence: Aperture prefers Net30 invoicing if PO not available.

I've attached the W-9, COI, and our draft SOW for your review (filenames below). Can Redwood do a temporary invoice-only onboarding (60-day window) with controls (billing contact + auto-escalation) rather than requiring a PO for this pilot? What evidence and approvals do you need from us to enable that path?

Attachments: Aperture_W9.pdf, Aperture_Certificate_of_Insurance.pdf, Aperture_SOW_v1.pdf

Happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Sam Torres
Head of Partnerships
Aperture Analytics
sam.torres@aperture-analytics.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@aperture-analytics.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-02-03T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New pilot - procurement questions and docs attached

Hi Sam — thanks for the attachments and the clear summary.

Short answer: we can accommodate a temporary invoice-only onboarding for this pilot, subject to a documented exception and a few controls from both sides. Proposed approach:

1) Temporary exception window: 60 days from first invoice. During that window Aperture can bill us via invoice without a formal PO. After 60 days we will either (a) require a PO for ongoing billing, or (b) move to a committed/dedicated contract.

2) Required evidence from Aperture (we received these but need originals/signed copies):
- Completed W-9 (received)
- Certificate of insurance (received)
- Signed SOW (please sign and return via DocuSign link below)

3) Internal approvals: Procurement (PROC) + Finance need to sign off on the exception. I will open a Jira ticket and route for approvals; reference PROC-578.

4) Controls while invoice-only:
- Invoice cap: $5,000 total during exception window.
- Billing contact required and invoice PDF with line-level usage.
- Automatic hold if cumulative invoices exceed $5k until a PO or exec approval is provided.

Actions for Aperture:
- Please sign the attached SOW and return via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/sign/ABC-123-APERTURE
- Confirm the billing contact + email for invoicing.

Marcus and Priyom — can you confirm whether Finance is comfortable with the $5k cap and the 60-day exception (PROC-578)? If okay, I'll start the exception form and route for signatures.

Thanks — Lauren Bishop
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

-----
Attachments referenced: Aperture_W9.pdf, Aperture_Certificate_of_Insurance.pdf, Aperture_SOW_v1.pdf

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-02-04T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New pilot - procurement questions and docs attached

+1 to Lauren's plan. Finance is generally OK with a short invoice-only exception for low-dollar pilots if the following are in place:
- Signed SOW and W-9 on file
- COI confirming minimum limits (we have the COI but will verify limits)
- The $5k cap is enforced programmatically (we'll add a billing tag and automatic hold)

Priyom — can you create the Procure exception record and add the billing tag (pilot-invoice-only) on the HubSpot deal so AP automation picks it up? I'll validate the COI and then sign off.

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
